hero-subtitle: I build full-stack web applications — from the database schema to the interface the user sees.
hero-paragraph: Final-year Computer Engineering student at the Polytechnic of Leiria, on the evening programme — classes are at night and my days are free to work. Former intern at ITGlee, currently the developer behind an online ordering platform going live for a real client.
about-p1: I started programming in the 10th grade and never stopped. What began as curiosity — figuring out what happened on the other side of the screen — became how I solve problems.
about-p2: In secondary school I learned the fundamentals of several languages and interned at ITGlee, where I built an online computer-hardware store with warehouse management in OutSystems: catalogue and checkout for the customer, a stock application for whoever runs the inventory. It was the first code of mine to solve a real company's problem, and the foundation I built my secondary-school final project on.
about-p3: My Computer Engineering degree at the Polytechnic of Leiria took that further — Databases, Data Structures & Algorithms, Advanced Programming, Software Engineering and Distributed Applications — applied in team projects with real deadlines, shifting requirements, and code other people had to read.
about-p4: Today I'm the developer behind Licas, an online ordering platform for an artisan pastry shop: React, TypeScript and Supabase, with role-based access, order and quote management, coupons and automated notifications. It's my first project with real users and real consequences — and where I've learned the most in the least time.
about-p5: I'm looking for my first full-time developer role. Because my classes run in the evening, I can start now. I'm drawn to work where the backend matters: architecture, data modelling and security.
projects-design-text: Two translation exercises: from Figma prototype to working interface. The focus here is visual fidelity and behaviour, not architecture.
contacts-text: I'm looking for my first full-time developer role. If you have an opening, a project, or just a question about any of this work — get in touch.
modal-tooltip-note: Note: This project is hosted on a free server. If there have been no recent accesses, the server may take 1 to 2 minutes to start up on the first click. Thank you for your patience!
meta-description: Full-stack developer and final-year Computer Engineering student at the Polytechnic of Leiria. React, TypeScript, Laravel, Java and Docker. Online ordering platform in production for a real client. Available for a first full-time role.
